baseline_models.focus_anchor: The adjacent predicates الغفور and الودود join consequence-shielding to affectionate attachment.
baseline_models.mechanism: The first predicate covers fault while protecting its bearer from the fault's effect; the second keeps the protected bearer inside a relation of affection. The pair therefore describes relational repair, not two unrelated dispositions.

activation_trace.role: Forgiving cover shields the offender from consequence and supplies the protective half of repair.
Affection and loving attachment make the shield relational rather than merely procedural.

changed_reading.before: He cancels faults and, separately, feels love.
changed_reading.after: He protects a person from a fault's aftermath in a way that preserves or restores affectionate attachment.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The sequence الغفور الودود permits protective covering to be read beside the wish or desire branch of و د د.
baseline_models.mechanism: Protective covering supplies a concrete act of care, while desire supplies its orientation toward a wanted good. On this reading, pardon is not indifferent concealment but shelter directed toward restoration.

activation_trace.role: A protective cover supplies the sheltering action of the paired description.
Wishing for something to come about gives the shelter a desired restorative outcome.

changed_reading.before: الودود names only an inward emotion added after pardon.
changed_reading.after: الودود can orient protective pardon toward a good actively desired for the covered person.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The remote wound-relapse branch of غ ف ر remains attached to الغفور, and الودود supplies enduring attachment beside it.
baseline_models.mechanism: If the relapse image is allowed to remain live, the pair can portray care that does not expire when a wound worsens again. This is a medical-material resonance, not the primary lexical gloss of الغفور.

activation_trace.role: A wound or illness relapsing supplies recurrence as the problem to which pardon may respond.
Loving attachment supplies continuity of care across the relapse.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness is a completed, one-time transaction.
changed_reading.after: Forgiving love can be carried exploratorily as care that remains available when injury or failure recurs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context keeps marks and witnesses visible, then supplies ك ف ر as a cover that hides truth. Against that, غ ف ر covers fault and shields its bearer. The shared covering image is ethically reversed: loving pardon protects the person without requiring the witnessed truth to disappear.

activation_trace.role: Covering fault while shielding its bearer identifies what merciful covering protects.
Affection supplies the relational purpose that distinguishes protection from suppression.
The split-root image of a visible identifying mark activates a marked, still-legible record rather than erasure.
Presence with direct witnessing keeps the underlying event available to view.
Covering truth supplies the negative counterpart that clarifies merciful covering by contrast.

structural_cues: The paired witness and witnessed in 85:3, followed by witnesses in 85:7 and 85:9, keep disclosure active around the focus.
The focus places affectionate attachment directly after the protective form of covering.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a visible-mark split mapping, repeated witnessing, truth-covering, consequence-shielding, and affection; I infer that what gets covered determines the moral direction: truth remains visible while the person's damaging aftermath is covered. A live alternative is that the two covering roots are only lexical resonance and الغفور carries ordinary pardon without this contrast.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness makes the incriminating event disappear.
changed_reading.after: The wrong can remain publicly witnessed while forgiving love shields the person from its destructive remainder; mercy is not falsification.

context_deltas.mechanism: Fortress, trench, encirclement, and guarding turn the focus pair into competing architectures of containment. The persecuting scene encloses people in a cut filled with fire; the later divine enclosure surrounds the apparent encirclers. Protective covering joined to attachment becomes a counter-enclosure that guards rather than traps.

activation_trace.role: A shielding cover supplies the focus's protective enclosure.
Loving attachment makes the protective boundary hospitable rather than carceral.
Fortified towers establish a large-scale image of defended enclosure.
A long sunken trench supplies the hostile enclosure imposed on the victims.
Overpowering encirclement reverses the geometry by placing the apparent encirclers inside a greater boundary.
Guarding and watchful care provide the non-destructive function of the divine boundary.

structural_cues: In 85:6 the persecutors sit over the fire they have enclosed, while 85:20 places God behind and around them.
The focus stands between the return of 85:13 and the throne and will of 85:15-16, giving its shelter sovereign scale.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hostile trenching, fortification, overpowering circumference, guarding, protective cover, and attachment; I infer a reversal from trapping enclosure to guarding enclosure. Alternatively, these spatial images may describe separate scenes and need not form one counter-architecture.

changed_reading.before: الودود is a soft feeling that does not alter the persecuting scene's geometry.
changed_reading.after: Forgiving love acts as counter-enclosure: it guards those whom violence tried to trap and encloses the agents who presumed themselves outside consequence.

context_deltas.mechanism: The wish branch of و د د is activated first by a promise that opens hope, then by deliberate action and sovereign will. Desire in الودود is therefore not helpless wishing: it can be the purposive good that the acting subject is able to bring about, with الغفور naming its reparative form.

activation_trace.role: Wishing for an outcome supplies the desired good latent in الودود.
Consequence-shielding gives the desired good a concrete reparative form.
A spoken promise that opens hope moves desire toward an expected outcome.
Bringing an act into being supplies efficacy rather than mere inward inclination.
Will and intention connect the desired outcome to sovereign action.

structural_cues: The promised day opens the context, while 85:16 closes the immediate divine-name sequence with doing whatever is willed.
The focus's two predicates put the reparative act before the desire that motivates it.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hope-opening promise, wish, consequence-shielding, enacted deed, and will; I infer a desire-to-realization arrow in which loving purpose becomes effective pardon. Alternatively, the promise and will may concern judgment broadly rather than specifying what الودود desires.

changed_reading.before: Divine love is benevolent feeling whose realization remains unspecified.
changed_reading.after: الودود names purposive desire backed by the capacity to enact the promised repair expressed by الغفور.

context_deltas.mechanism: The assay-and-burning field identifies grave enacted harm, yet punishment in 85:10 is attached to not repenting. A summons to repentance and the later image of return activate الغفور الودود as a live route back even from that harm. The route does not trivialize the fire because consequence remains attached to refusing it.

activation_trace.role: Pardon that shields from consequence supplies the possible destination of repentance.
Loving attachment makes return relational restoration rather than escape from penalty alone.
Burning and its blackening residue establish the severity of the harm from which return would occur.
Calling another to repentance supplies an offered opening rather than an automatic acquittal.
Returning after departure provides the directional movement into restored attachment.

structural_cues: The phrase ثم لم يتوبوا in 85:10 makes non-repentance, not merely prior harm, part of the punishment clause.
The statement that He returns immediately precedes الغفور الودود.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies burning harm, a repentance summons, return, pardon, and attachment; I infer that return can terminate in forgiving relationship even for agents of grave harm, while refusal preserves consequence. A live alternative is that the repentance language only states culpability and does not define the scope of الودود.

changed_reading.before: The severe judgment and the forgiving-loving names describe mutually exclusive classes with no movement between them.
changed_reading.after: The names keep a demanding return path open inside judgment: grave harm is not minimized, but refusal to return is not treated as inevitable.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's protective cover is expanded by the hidden garden, continuing provision, and a river cut through earth. Pardon becomes more than removal of liability: it opens an inhabitable, sustained environment in which attachment can endure.

activation_trace.role: Protective covering supplies the basic shelter that the context makes inhabitable.
Affection supplies the relationship meant to live within the shelter.
A garden hidden by its trees turns covering into a protected place one can inhabit.
Continuous provision and gift keep the protected habitat from being a one-time refuge.
A watercourse cutting through earth gives sustained repair a concrete nourishing flow.

structural_cues: The garden promise of 85:11 precedes the focus and contrasts materially with the trench and fire of 85:4-5.
Both الغفور and the garden branch organize protection through covering, but only the garden makes the cover a dwelling.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies protective cover, a tree-hidden garden, continuous provision, flowing water, and attachment; I infer that pardon opens a durable relational habitat rather than merely deleting a charge. Alternatively, the garden may remain reward imagery independent of the mechanics of forgiveness.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness is subtraction: a penalty is removed and nothing positive replaces it.
changed_reading.after: Forgiving love is reparative habitation: shelter, continuing provision, and relationship occupy the space opened by pardon.

context_deltas.mechanism: The severe grasp is attributed to the same رب whose branch inventory includes nurturing, repair, and completion. The focus then names pardon and love. This prevents love from being read as inability to confront persecuting force and prevents force from exhausting the agent's identity.

activation_trace.role: Consequence-shielding directs capability toward repair after force has stopped the harm.
Affection establishes that severe capability and relational care coexist in the same subject.
Forceful overpowering grasp supplies the capacity to interrupt violent domination.
Nurturing, repairing, and bringing to completion keep lordly power oriented toward restoration.
Strength and solidity make the protective capacity effective against entrenched harm.

structural_cues: The severe grasp in 85:12, beginning and return in 85:13, and forgiving-loving pair in 85:14 share one continuous pronominal subject.
The persecutors' coercive force earlier in the context gives protective force a concrete object to stop.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies overpowering force, nurturing completion, strength, pardon, and affection under one subject; I infer that severity can function to halt abuse so that repair becomes possible. Alternatively, 85:12 may concern retribution alone, without assigning it an instrumental role in loving restoration.

changed_reading.before: الودود signals softness, while severe power belongs to an incompatible register.
changed_reading.after: Forgiving love is force-capable care: able to stop persecuting power, yet not reducible to the severity used against it.

context_deltas.mechanism: The remote relapse image in غ ف ر becomes more than an isolated curiosity when the immediately preceding verse pairs beginning with return. Loving attachment then supplies continuity across cycles: repair can begin again when a wound or failure returns.

activation_trace.role: Relapse of a wound or illness supplies the recurring breakdown that calls for renewed repair.
Enduring attachment carries care across repeated breakdown and recovery.
Beginning explicitly paired with repetition supplies the restart side of iterative repair.
Return after departure activates recurrence while also making renewed approach possible.

structural_cues: The beginning-and-return pair immediately precedes الغفور الودود.
The two focus predicates are durative descriptions rather than a narration of one completed pardon event.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies beginning, return, literal wound relapse, and attachment; I infer a cycle in which returned damage can meet renewed repair. A live alternative is that 85:13 refers only to origination and eschatological return, leaving the medical branch an accidental echo.

changed_reading.before: Pardon repairs a single past breach and is exhausted by recurrence.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, الغفور الودود names repeatable repair: when damage returns, loving care can begin again.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the stake sense of و د د is dialectal and form-distant from الودود. It remains anchored in the supplied focus branch and gains a coherent material frame from protective cover, tightened bond, and raised canopy. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy: love is the peg that keeps mercy's cover standing, not as a lexical translation of الودود.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: غ ف ر supplies a protective cover and the dialectal branch of و د د supplies a peg within the two-word focus construction.

activation_trace.role: Protective covering supplies the canopy-like mercy that requires support.
The dialectal stake image supplies an anchoring support for the protective cover.
A tightened knot or bond explains materially how the support holds.
A raised roof or canopy completes the shelter architecture around the focus pair.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness and love are adjacent abstractions.
changed_reading.after: As a contained material resonance, forgiveness is a sheltering canopy and attachment is the peg that keeps it durably raised.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the lunar-mansion branch of غ ف ر is a remote nominal use and could be merely homonymic. It remains traceable to الغفور and is unusually activated by the opening sky and celestial-tower images. Downstream prose should qualify it as cosmic-navigational resonance, not claim that الغفور literally denotes a constellation here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus word الغفور carries a supplied branch naming a three-star lunar station, while الودود keeps the resonance relational.

activation_trace.role: A three-star lunar mansion supplies the image of a recurring celestial station.
Affection prevents the celestial station from becoming a merely astronomical abstraction.
The sky as what rises and overshadows supplies the domain in which the remote focus branch becomes visible.
Celestial towers organize the sky into stations and activate the lunar-mansion resonance.

changed_reading.before: The focus names two qualities without spatial or periodic resonance.
changed_reading.after: As a contained cosmic echo, forgiving love becomes a recurring station by which a world under the sky's witness may reorient itself.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because جماء الغفير is an idiomatic crowd branch far from the divine adjective's ordinary force. It remains focus-anchored and is independently activated by contextual totality and gathering. Downstream prose should render it as a social resonance of pardon gathering people without rank-based remainder, not as a claim that الغفور means crowd in this ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus branch for غ ف ر supplies the whole crowd with none absent, and و د د supplies attachment among those gathered.

activation_trace.role: The entire crowd arriving with none left behind supplies collective scope to pardon.
Mutual affection turns aggregate gathering into restored social attachment.
Totality and complete inclusion amplify the no-one-left-behind scope.
Gathering and collection supply the movement by which dispersed persons become one assembly.

changed_reading.before: Forgiveness concerns isolated individuals one case at a time.
changed_reading.after: As a contained social resonance, forgiving love regathers a whole divided body into attachment without leaving status groups outside.

strongest_changes: Covering split into two opposed operations: كفر hides truth, while غفر leaves truth witnessed and shields the person from destructive consequence.
The wish branch of الودود became efficacious desire when read through promise, deliberate action, and will.
Trench, circumference, and guarding turned forgiving love into a reversal from hostile containment to protective enclosure.
Beginning and return activated the remote relapse branch, preserving an exploratory model of repeatable repair.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's brevity made adjacency unusually productive: covering acquired its moral direction from love, while context repeatedly changed that pair across evidentiary, spatial, volitional, legal, ecological, forceful, medical, material, celestial, and collective mechanisms without forcing them into one final reading.
remaining_uncertainties: The visible-mark activation uses a legitimate but non-dominant split mapping of س م و and should remain secondary to the witness and covering contrast.
The repentance model infers that the open return path illuminates the scope of الودود; the packet does not explicitly state the endpoint of repentance.
The relapse, peg, lunar-mansion, and whole-crowd branches are packet-grounded but form-distant, so they should remain qualified resonances rather than lexical claims.
